origin.description: Read the vignette header lines from one file.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: Path of a vignette source file.

origin.details: Keyword is kept as one string. Keywords is split on commas. No engine means utils::Sweave.
origin.value: A list with file, title, depends, keywords, and engine.
origin.example:
f <- tempfile(fileext=".Rnw")
writeLines("% \\VignetteIndexEntry{A Title}", f)
info <- vignetteInfo(f)
cat(info$title, info$engine, "\n")

translation.description: Read the vignette header lines from one file.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: Path of a vignette source file.

translation.details: Keyword is kept as one string. Keywords is split on commas. No engine means utils::Sweave.
translation.value: A list with file, title, depends, keywords, and engine.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from tools.vignette import vignette_info
f = Path(tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".Rnw"))
f.write_text("% \\VignetteIndexEntry{A Title}\n")
info = vignette_info(f)
print(info["title"], info["engine"])
